entities.note: pink 2x2 square at rows 40-41, cols 10-11, standing on the red start pad at the bottom-left of the playfield; moves 2 px per press
blue 2x2 square at rows 20-21, cols 24-25 on an identical red pad at the top-right of the playfield

red walkable floor: 6x6 start pad rows 38-43 cols 8-13, 6x6 goal pad rows 18-23 cols 22-27, 4x4 pad rows 30-33 cols 8-11; the player can only stand on coloured floor, the colour-4 playfield background is not walkable
4x4 checkerboard of colour 9 and 4 at rows 34-37, cols 8-11, directly above the start pad: solid; button9 turns it into a solid-fill walkable tile (and vice versa)
solid-fill 4x4 colour-9 tile at rows 20-23, cols 18-21, just left of the goal pad: walkable; button9 turns it into a checkerboard wall (linked with checker9: one press swaps both)
walkable strip at rows 30-33: cols 12-17 colour 8, cols 18-21 colour 13 (horizontal, joins pad2 to tile9's column); button8 reshapes it into a vertical column cols 18-21 rows 24-33
colour-8 pad (rows 17-21, cols 42-54) on the grey right-hand panel inside a 1-px black frame; its colour matches strip8
colour-9 pad (rows 34-38, cols 42-54) inside a black frame; its colour matches checker9/tile9; both black frames vanish on the first button press
grey control panel filling cols 32-63, rows 10-53, with a dashed black/grey divider at cols 32-33; solid, the player cannot enter it
colour-3 bands rows 0-9 and rows 54-62 above and below the 44-row playfield
row 63: black = remaining steps, colour 3 grows from the left as steps are spent (128 at L1; moves cost 1, button clicks 2, a fall 20)

rules.note: a move into a checker tile, the panel or off the coloured floor onto the colour-4 background is reverted; the step is still spent (same for ACTION2/3/4)
the checker wall above the start pad becomes a solid-fill walkable colour-9 tile (press again to swap back); costs 2 steps
at the same press the solid tile beside the goal becomes a checker wall (and back): the two colour-9 tiles always swap together
the 8/13 floor strip switches between its horizontal form (rows 30-33, cols 12-21) and a vertical form (cols 18-21, rows 24-33) that reaches up to the goal pad; costs 2 steps

if the player is standing on the tile that would become a wall, an iris-close 'fall' animation plays, 20 steps are deducted and the toggle is reverted (same for button8 when standing on the part of the strip that disappears)
clicking floor, panel or empty space does nothing but costs 1 step

goal.note: the pink square must sit exactly on the blue square (rows 20-21, cols 24-25); requires button9, up, right, button8, up, button9 again, up, right (20 actions)
